Paragraph: "Without Seetha, these joyful songs feel like piercing arrows in my heart; what is pleasant to others brings only sorrow to me..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Joyful soundscapes feel painful and sharp due to emotional heartbreak.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama identifies the sharp dissonance between his inner pain and the external joy.
Outcome/Resolution: He acknowledges how grief alters perception, turning sweet sounds into painful sensations.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Shoka-Drishti (Perceiving the world through the painful lens of grief)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Shows how the internal state colors all external perception; without inner peace or love, even paradise feels painful.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Anhedonia and negative cognitive bias: inability to enjoy universally pleasant stimuli, experiencing them as emotionally painful.
